lede: Grand Theft Auto VI was the most travelled subject of the day, surfacing on Wikipedia, YouTube, Google Trends and Lemmy at once. The loudest of the four was a Lemmy post voted past 670, reporting that reverse engineers had the game running on PC against Rockstar's wishes. Two Avengers: Doomsday TV spots built on Magneto and Doctor Doom drew 3.8 million YouTube views between them. Wikipedia's single most-read article, though, was neither of those: a guitarist, Andy Taylor, at 318,400 views.

throughlines.title: Avengers Doomsday | Magneto vs Doom | Get Your Tickets at TGV Now
throughlines.gist: A Magneto versus Doctor Doom teaser for Avengers: Doomsday, climbing in its second day across Wikipedia and YouTube, where the ticket spot alone has drawn 2.76 million views.

throughlines.title: Grand Theft Auto VI
throughlines.gist: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto VI, launched November 19 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, is now ten days on the feeds and holding, still pulling readers on Wikipedia and viewers on YouTube.
throughlines.why: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto VI launched on November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, and this weekend is its first on sale.

throughlines.title: gta 6 pc port
throughlines.gist: The separate scramble to get GTA VI running on PC, live on Google Trends and YouTube for eight days, after Rockstar moved to squash the biggest recompilation effort.
